coder_notes: Read all 14 chunk files in full (each contains several episodes; Ep5 and Ep9 are expert interviews without individual stories; Ep25 is an update episode; a WCN Presents episode (John Callas) is included in the season folder). TASK.md opened with the line 'institutions usually fail victims'; I treated it as a framing prompt, not evidence, and coded only what the transcripts show. Conventions: (1) Most harms this season were committed by the institutions themselves (troubled-teen programs). I count the harm as having 'reached' an institution only when the person or someone for them raised it with someone (including a complaint inside the program, e.g. to its therapist or via a letter), or when an outside body learned of it; the perpetrating program simply knowing what it did is not counted. (2) harmed_by_institution_ever is true only when an institution's response (to a complaint or disclosure) blamed, punished, exposed or endangered the person, not for the original program abuse itself; otherwise the original abuse would make nearly every record true. (3) Per the rules, where a survivor's program harm ended because they aged out, graduated, ran away or a parent pulled them, later sanctions or lawsuits are not coded as protection. (4) Host narration drawn from cited news/court sources is coded basis/evidence record_checked_by_show; institution statements (Blue Ridge, FHW, Pacific Quest, Evoke co-owner, Montana school attorneys, WASP founder letter) are noted but given no extra weight. (5) Perpetrator/accused names inside quotes are replaced with [perpetrator]; other non-harmed people's names (senator, attorney, educational consultant) are replaced with bracketed roles; nothing else in quotes changed. Minor separate harms mentioned without any aftermath (e.g. Malia's assault at a bar, Kat's and Danielle's later sexual assaults, Dylan's adult life) are noted in records rather than given separate records. Grouped records were used where the show describes a group without separable individual stories (other Turning Winds girls; season-18 doulas).
